content: Mbuul a mpem a Sɔl
Yàmɛnà naa utaaŋ alan, Sɔl kàkwen anki uwɛy mupà alɔŋki a Mwol mpay a ukwà. Nde kàkàman undweer a angaŋ,
ntɔn mulɔm in'kaan mubilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà u Damas, isàkal naa nde kan'man baar, itàkal abaal itàkal akaar abà bàläbà Mbwo, nde waa kakɔr anà katwääl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Wɛɛ mpal kàkäl nde u mbwo tsütsü a Damas, kà imbürà, un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà kàfü du, waa kun'diŋà.
Nde kàbü u mɛɛn, waa kàwem ndaa yàmutɛɛnà a nde naa: « Sɔl, Sɔl, ntɔn nkye an'mɛɛyà ngye nkwaaŋ? »
Nde kàfuul naa: « Ngye awà nà, Mwol? » Ndaa waa itɛn naa: « Ɛɛ, mɛ in'wà Yɛsu akwà ngye, afàmɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ.
Wɛɛ mbarà, bilà uboo a bul, bàkyer akakyään undiir ayàkyer ngye kwo. »
Abaal kàyilyaaŋà nde abà, bàkyer atsum mun, ba bàweemà ndaa, wɛɛ ba mbuur bàmɛn anki.
Sɔl kàsubà u mɛɛn, itàkal naa mii ande myàkäl myàŋàduub, nde undiir kàmɛnà anki. Ba bun'te mpi u kɔɔ ntɔn mukun'syen Damas.
Nde kàkäl ilä itär ukɔɔn aman, ukɔɔn adyà anà ukɔɔn anwà.
Kyekà kàkäl anà un'lɔŋki mwɛy u Damas ikɔb ande Ananyas. Mwol kàkàmɛnà akà nde unsà imanmii, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ananyas! » Nde kàfuur naa: « Mɛ awà, Mwol. »
Mwol kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kyen uboo a balàbal bàfàbel balàbal a lää, u ndwà a Yudasi, fuul mbuur mwɛy wà Tarsɛ ikɔb ande Sɔl. Nde wàmukayamà taaŋ nsil alà,
wɛɛ uboo a imanmii, nde kan'man mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas wàmubilà anà kàmusà an'kɔɔ ntɔn nde ufàman. »
Ananyas waa ufuur naa: « Mwol, mɛ an'wem akà baar mbɔɔn ube banswà kàkyer mbuur awà akà aŋin'kyɛɛl angye u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Kyakin, apà nde kan'yà anà ikɔ̈b bun'pɛ amfum a angaŋ mukɔr baar banswà bàkayamà ikɔb angye. »
Wɛɛ Mwol kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kyen, ntɔn mbuur awà mɛ amun'sɔɔl asànaa un'syääl amɛ musyen ikɔb amɛ kusà a baar mpa abà Ayudà, kusà a amfum anà kusà a baan a Isàlɛl.
Mɛ ŋakwo in'yun'swaŋ indiir byanswà usàman nde mpay ntɔn mɛ. »

Ananyas waa kàkyen. Nde kàbilà u ndwà, kun'si an'kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Sɔl, un'tɔŋ amɛ, Mwol kàman'tɔm, Yɛsu akwà kàyàmɛnà akà ngye u mbwo kàfü ngye, ntɔn ngye afàman anà akäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl. »
Utaaŋ nsil alan, indiir imwɛy asànaa ibal byàbwee fà mii a Sɔl, laa kàfàman nde. Nde waa kambarà, waa bun'dümà.
Ungö apan nde kàkyer adyà, waa kàwɛl ngwal. An'lɔɔŋ a Sɔl u Damas Sɔl kàkäl ndam a ilä anà alɔŋki bàkäl u Damas.
Itaan a mbɔɔn anki, nde kàsɛmà mukyään uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà naa Yɛsu wà Mwan a Nzam.

Apan, baar banswà bàweemà nde bàkäl unsà ubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nkye wunà kà mbuur akwà anki kàmɛɛyà baar bàfàbel ikɔb aki kwaaŋ u Yɛlusàlɛm? Nkye apà nde kàyi anki ntɔn mukɔr anà musyen ba akamfum a angaŋ? »
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkäl ngwal mbɔɔn muswaŋ akà Ayudà bàkäl u Damas naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ.
Ungö a ilä mbɔɔn, Ayudà banswà bàdirà mukun'dwa.
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàyöb ndaa ayin. Mpib anà mwäänà, ba bàkaseyà ibeenà a bul alà, ntɔn mukun'dwa.
Abun, alɔŋki a Sɔl bun'syen u mpib ntɔn mukun'sweey u ntsü yumwɛy yà ibää a bul. Ba bun'twey uboo a un'tɛr.
Sɔl u Yɛlusàlɛm
Mpal kan'kɔlà nde u Yɛlusàlɛm, Sɔl kàsi mutüüb anà alɔŋki. Wɛɛ ba banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba bàkyey anki naa nde akyàbulà un'lɔŋki ndandaa.
Abun, Banàbasi waa kun'wɛl, kun'syen akà Antööm, waa kasam ndaa kàmɛn Sɔl Mwol u mbwo anà kàyääm nde anà nde. Nde kasam sye naa Sɔl kàlɔŋ anà uyɔl kà ikɔb a Yɛsu u Damas.
Sɛmà apan, Sɔl kàkälà anà ba u Yɛlusàlɛm anà mulɔŋà anà nuyɔl kà ikɔb a Mwol.
Nde sye kayakyäänà Ayudà bàfatɛɛnà Ingɛlɛki anà kàfasaa mbaaŋ anà ba. Wɛɛ ba bàlɛŋà mukun'dwa.
Mpal ban'wem atɔŋ ndaa ayi, ba bun'syen Sɛzarɛ, akun ba bun'töm Tarse.
U Yuday lanswà, sɛmà Ngalilɛ anà Samàlya, Ikööŋ kyanswà kyàkäl unsà duu, kyàwɛlà ngwal, kyàwemà Mwol bɔɔmà, anà kyàyɛlà u ngwal a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Nkɔɔr a Ɛnɛ
Yàmɛnà naa Petɔlà kàfilyaŋà ntsü yanswà, waa kàtyà sye akà baar in'kyɛɛl bàkäl u Lidà.
Nde kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy kwo ikɔb ande Ɛnɛ, wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n udu a ntäŋ, fà mbul naan nde kàkäl aŋàkwɛkà.
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ɛnɛ, Yɛsu Klistɔ kàmakɔɔr! Mbarà, bwɛlà ntäŋ angye, ngye ŋakwo. » Apan sye, Ɛnɛ waa kambarà.
Mpal bun'mɛn baar a Lidà anà baar a Sarɔn banswà, ba bàbuul mpem aba amu Mwol.
Ngwiiyà a Dɔkasi
U Yɔpɛ kàkäl anà un'lɔŋki mwɛy wà un'kaar ikɔb ande Tabità, ikaswaŋà naa Dɔkasi u ndaa aba, waa ifiswaŋà naa Nsey. Taaŋ lanswà nde kàfakyerà ndaa aŋàbwaŋ anà kàfabayà aŋàlàmbwà.
Umpal ayin, nde kàkyer abɛɛl, waa kàkü. Ungö mukun'ywɛy, ba bun'si u suk adu.
Mpal bàwem alɔŋki a Yɔpɛ naa Petɔlà wà u Lidà, bul a tsütsü anà ba, ba bàtöm abaal abɔ̈ɔ̈l ntɔn mukun'bel anà mutɛn naa: « Bi kàmabɔɔn, yà akà bi làgyägyä. »

Apan, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà, waa kàkyen anà ba. Umpal kàkɔlà nde, ba bun'syen u suk adu. Akweel adim bàyi kusà a nde, bàmulel anà muswaŋ ba inkur anà ipfɛy a mpye kàfakyerà Dɔkasi mpal bàkäl ba banswà.
Apan, Petɔlà kàtwey baar banswà, nde kàbü an'köm, kàyamà, waa kàbulà ntsü yàkäl ndom anà mutɛn naa: « Tabità, mbarà! » Nde kàduub mii, mpal kàmɛn nde Petɔlà, waa kàbwaay.
Abun, Petɔlà kàsilà kɔɔ ande, waa kun'mbaar. Nde kàbel baar in'kyɛɛl anà akweel adim, waa kun'mɛɛy, wà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Baar a Yɔpɛ banswà bàwem ba ndaa ayi, bàmbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà akà Mwol.
Petɔlà kàkäl ilä mbɔɔn u Yɔpɛ akà un'kwaam a ibaan, ikɔb ande Simɔn.
